sourceTitle: Washed Ashore; Or, The Tower of Stormount Bay
description: "Washed Ashore; or, The Tower of Stormount Bay" by W.H.G. Kingston is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around young Jack Askew, who lives in Stormount Tower on the south coast of England.
